body:
In your test case in string 'custom.articles' what is "custom" supposed to be?  If it's mean to be vendor name then the usage is incorrect. It should be `custom/articles` or rather `Custom/Articles`.

For your second eg. instead of  `'plugin.gourmet/faker.articles'`  try `'plugin.Gourmet/Faker.Articles'`.

Does not work.

I understand that for custom you're wondering what it is for but I wondered the same when i saw this: https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/3.0/src/TestSuite/Fixture/FixtureManager.php#L159-L161

I was just trying to tell you guys that there is an edge case you guys seem to want to cover that fails hard (undefined variable). Maybe these lines should throw an exception instead?

That "else" case you pointed out is interesting. I never knew fixtures were meant to use any prefix besides 'app', 'core', 'plugin'. 

I'll let someone who does know about it look into it :)

`plugin.Gourmet\Faker.Articles` will work :) Found an example usage [here](https://github.com/FriendsOfCake/Authenticate/blob/cake3/tests/TestCase/Auth/MultiColumnAuthenticateTest.php#L19).  Though given that we use forward slash at all other places in plugin name it should be changed.

Thanks! This worked, but ya - some things need to be ironed out:
- the `else`: if to be supported then it's triggering an undefined variable.
- Gourmet/Email: why different notation than everywhere else.
Would you like to submit a PR to fix the second point?  Should be an easy fix.
